t: Anatomy of a Bug: Debugging an HTMX Workflow with an AI Partner
s: This article details a debugging session of an HTMX workflow in the Pipulate project, showcasing human-AI collaboration to integrate a new data source from the Botify API. The core challenge involved a 'tricky' code transplant requiring careful template rewiring and dynamic configuration, highlighting AI's role in complex development tasks.
sub: HTMX workflow extension by adding a new data source (Botify API)
Code transplanting strategy ('WET' principle) and 'tricky' vs. 'standard' transplant classification
AI-assisted debugging and collaborative development, including correction of AI-generated errors
Template configuration and dynamic step definition in evolving systems
AI confirmation bias and context window management in conversational AI
